primitives.name: Wafer Thinning Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: US 9,743,848 B2 15 wafer thinning to sub-hundreds micron to reduce the package height in multi-chip modules.
primitives.assumptions: Wafer thickness reduction linearly correlates with package height decrease; multi-chip module geometry permits stacking without mechanical interference.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t_wafer < 100 microns, thermal stress exceeds material tolerance.

layer2.mapping: Enables compact physical layout for wearable systems; supports modular integration of heterogeneous circuits under strict spatial constraints.

primitives.name: Horizontal Spacing Minimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: 8B, two or more electrically-coupled circuit boards of a multi-chip module may be provided in a physiological measurement system in a horizontally spaced manner to minimize the height of the circuit board.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_{total}': 'total system height (mm)', 'H_{board}': 'individual board height (mm)', 'd_{spacing}': 'horizontal spacing between boards (mm)'}
primitives.assumptions: Circuit boards are arranged in parallel planes; electrical coupling does not require vertical alignment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If d_{spacing} approaches zero, electromagnetic interference increases beyond acceptable limits.

layer2.mapping: Maps to 2D layout optimization in embedded systems; enables miniaturization while preserving signal integrity.
layer2.telemetry: System height reduction achieved via board spacing optimization

primitives.name: Motion Filtered Heart Rate Estimation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Exemplary systems include a processing module configured to filter the raw photoplethysmography data received from the light detectors to minimize contributions due to motion, and subsequently process the filtered data to detect peaks in the data that correspond with heart beats of a user.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\hat{HR}(t)': 'estimated heart rate (bpm)', 'PPG(t)': 'photoplethysmographic signal (mV)', '\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{motion}}': 'motion artifact suppression filter'}
primitives.assumptions: Signal-to-noise ratio improves post-motion filtering; peak detection algorithm assumes sinusoidal waveform structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-intensity motion (>5g acceleration) causes signal saturation or aliasing.

layer2.mapping: Integrates accelerometer-based motion compensation into PPG-based HR estimation; enhances robustness under dynamic conditions.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of estimated HR relative to ECG reference during motion
